cycle04TechnicalScope: Preserve all Cycle 03 form and surfacing; repair only exported functional pivots, pivot-local children, and collision transform/bounds.

components.functionOriginAndServiceContext: Two open A-leg pairs carry the crown and sheave over the entry shaft. Helix/MTS surface head-frame, ART EXTRAPOLATION.
components.substrateManufactureAndFinish: Rolled wide-flange mild steel, splice plates at the A-bar, dark alkyd over zinc phosphate.
components.interfacesLoadAccessAndHeatPaths: Load: shoe -> leg -> A-bar/splice -> crown beam -> sheave. One platform-side portal. No A-plane rungs.
components.expectedOpticalResponse: Dark dielectric paint, metallic worn web/flange edges, orange edge wear not tape.

components.functionOriginAndServiceContext: Drum on -X skid pays the umbilical; sheave on the crown turns it down the shaft.
components.substrateManufactureAndFinish: Machined steel drum, flanges, spindle; grooved sheave in cheek plates; heat/oil on gearbox.
components.interfacesLoadAccessAndHeatPaths: Pillow blocks on skid; cable leaves a visible tangent, rises, wraps the sheave, drops through the collar.
components.expectedOpticalResponse: Metallic oil-stained winch, greasy dark cable, interface steel on sheave flanges.

components.functionOriginAndServiceContext: Short curb around the empty entry shaft. The tower stands over this hole.
components.substrateManufactureAndFinish: Painted steel annulus with wall thickness. Hole is empty.
components.interfacesLoadAccessAndHeatPaths: Collar sits on the cut face; cable drop occupies the centre without filling it.
components.expectedOpticalResponse: Dark dusty curb, real cavity, no halo.

components.functionOriginAndServiceContext: Paired fixtures on the crown looking into the shaft.
components.substrateManufactureAndFinish: Hollow cast dark-steel hood, socket, physically recessed warm glass lens.
components.interfacesLoadAccessAndHeatPaths: Arm from crown beam; open hood mouth tilted toward the well so its thick dark rim survives works_top before the smaller lens.
components.expectedOpticalResponse: Two dark hood/socket masses with smaller restrained lenses; fixture remains legible with emission off.

components.functionOriginAndServiceContext: Four folded pads transfer the A-frame load into the asteroid crust.
components.substrateManufactureAndFinish: Dark alkyd folded steel shoe with a smaller exposed metallic anchor plate and interface bolts.
components.interfacesLoadAccessAndHeatPaths: Each leg terminates through gussets into its own plate; the exposed plate stays inside the physical shoe footprint.
components.expectedOpticalResponse: Four separate corner masses at works_site, materially separated from the dark frame without glow, stripe, outline, or padding.
